letters-nda.g: The undertaking every person signs before touching client data
letters-nda.w: A confidentiality and non-disclosure undertaking rendered from the employee record, kept as the text that went out. In a collections business the borrower data an agent sees is the whole liability; the signed undertaking is what the client audit asks for.
s: Pick the employee and draft it — a blank placeholder refuses the letter.
Issue; print or save as PDF for signature.
File the signed copy under Document Tracker.
letters-nda.tip: Change the wording once under Letter Templates; every later NDA uses it, and the ones already issued do not change.
letters-nda.rel: Also see: Letter Templates, Document Tracker

sms-settings.w: The SMS provider (MSG91, Twilio or similar): API URL, key, sender id and DLT entity id. No transport is wired in this build — messages queue in the Messages Log until a provider is connected.
s: Register the sender id and templates on the DLT portal.
Add a row with the provider's API details and status active.
Add the approved templates under SMS Templates.
sms-settings.tip: An SMS whose content differs from the DLT-registered template is dropped by the operator without a bounce — keep the templates exact.
sms-settings.rel: Also see: SMS Templates, Send Message
